versions.content: SOME/IP Service search A defined ConsumedServiceIn- stance is searching for a SOME/IP Service Instance that fulfills all of the following conditions: • Service Identifier that matches the value set in serviceIdentifier , • Service Instance Identifier that matches the value set in instanceIdentifier or ANY Service Instance of the Service in case the instanceIdentifier is set to ANY . • Service major version that matches the value set in majorVersion , • Service major version: – in case versionDrivenFindBehavior = exactOrAnyMinorVersion : Service minor version that matches the value set in minorVersion or ANY minor version of the Service Instance in case the minorVersion is set to ANY – in case versionDrivenFindBehavior = minimumMinorVersion : Ser- vice minor version that matches at least the value set in minorVersion or is higher
